title: Bank simulation machine
statement: Given a natural number $d$ and a family of Boolean finite-tape machines indexed by $j<d$, define a machine with twice the bank's work tape count, Boolean alphabet, and cleaning states associated with the bank state type and bank tape count. It is the cleaning construction applied to the tagged machine family after padding each member to the bank's work tape count, with the distinguished initial state as its starting state.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $d$ and a family of Boolean finite-tape machines indexed by $j<d$
caveat: The provided definitions do not describe the cleaning construction, so its behavior cannot be stated more explicitly from the payload.
